risks.quote: It can reflect cultural biases in its training data
It is more energy intensive than other forms of internet use
The results generated may plagiarise the data that it was trained on
It can lead to superficial engagement with the material
There are concerns around data privacy when using tools not provided by the university, such as ChatGPT
Most importantly, GenAI can invent facts that seem plausible (‘hallucinations’)

responsibilities.quote: GenAI can invent facts that seem plausible (‘hallucinations’), therefore you must check everything it says with a reputable source, such as resources from the Library
We know that you'll probably use GenAI in your future career, and we want to make sure you know how to use this technology, so that you're ready for life after university.
